'''Meattail''' was a type of seafood that came from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. It was one of the products the trade [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Woebegone]]'' transported from Bal'demnic to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
